title: Mconet Artifact
description: Language-neutral Artifact data containing catalog-local identity, open classification, source representation, optional modality description, metadata, and namespaced extensions.
$comment: Copyright © 2026 Mcont. This Schema validates one Artifact structure. Catalog-wide ID uniqueness, reference resolution, source access, byte limits, transfer, decoding, and transformation remain separate runtime responsibilities.

kind.description: Open Artifact classification with optional semantic meaning.

mediaType.description: Optional original media type text retained without normalization.

source.description: Inline, URI-referenced, or integration-defined Artifact source.

artifactKind.description: Open Artifact classification with independent optional semantics and extensions.

artifactSource.description: Known sources enforce concrete payloads while unknown source kinds remain open.

inlineArtifactSource.description: Inline byte source whose in-memory byte carrier is runtime-specific.
inlineArtifactSource.$comment: The Web runtime requires Uint8Array. No language-neutral binary JSON encoding is committed by this Schema, so the required bytes member remains unconstrained here.

uriArtifactSource.description: URI source retaining an explicit absolute or relative reference without resolution.

unknownArtifactSource.description: Integration-defined source whose fields are owned by its defining integration.

artifactDescriptor.description: Open descriptor carrying at least one modality classification.

mediaTypeString.description: HTTP-style media type string with optional token or quoted parameters.

openIdentifier.description: Unicode-friendly open identifier with non-empty period-delimited segments.

jsonPrimitive.description: Primitive value represented directly by JSON.

jsonRecord.description: String-keyed JSON object whose values remain recursively JSON-compatible.
